body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties of one non-Critical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 during that time. This does not postpone Wounds or incapacitation.

surges.html: Extend the suppression through the end of your next turn.
Also suppress one ordinary penalty to the target's next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Time Thread
rider.html: Gain a Time Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one non-damaging benefit of that card ending at the start of your next turn instead ends at the end of that turn.
